added.member: More shared roles, motions and layout marks
added.summary: The default style dresses more role parts from tokens: tag (text over the scene), fade (a scroller's edge cue, placed with data-anchor=bottom-edge or top-edge), former (a struck former price), ribbon (ink is the contrast of its toned fill), skeleton and its shimmering sheen, divider, grip, notch, zone (a toned rim and wash, hatched for danger) and sweep (a cooldown veil). An SVG shape named track, fill, sweep, series, area, gridline, link or tail strokes and fills from role tokens. glyph (a stroked SVG mark) strokes in its text's colour, a picture with data-muted sets back, data-tone takes primary, a mass anchor's fill draws in --fill-color, and figure takes --figure-size and --figure-weight, and figures and badges use tabular numerals. aria-pressed counts as selected; data-shape gives cells and dots a shape, data-down dims a row, cell, card or frame, a disabled one dims its picture and icons, and a fill with data-ghost trails a loss. data-motion adds float (a figure flying off its anchor) and change (ease between states, now including opacity, translate and rotate), a scroll or cluster primitive with data-from=end starts at its end, and data-edge (x or y) fades a window's ends to clear.

fixed.summary: A keyframes rule that gives scale only at its start (a stamp or pop) now ends at no scaling on an element with no scale of its own, instead of warning that none is not a number and not playing.
A text decoration with no colour of its own (currentColor) now takes the colour of the element that declares it, as CSS Text Decoration says, instead of the text it is drawn across.
